'''Ecstamira''' is a [[Grass]] type [[Support]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Hyphoria]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "No longer content with weaving fleeting illusions, Ecstamira wants to shape even the living world into a place for sleeping. With spores that can lull the noisiest of [[Zobos]] into dazzling dreams, who knows when they'll wake up? Not until the entire world grows quiet, at least."

Ecstamira is a rainbow rarity Tatari. Like all Tier 4 evolutions, it requires B Rating to acquire, therefore its feeding level cannot be below B rating for each stat.

== Trivia ==
* Esctamira was added to the game on 07/15/2026 alongside [[Poakie]] and [[Hychroma]].
